lines.en: label karinspring1:
scene karinslife1
Hi! I’m Karin Kanda — a second year student at Kumon-mi High!
lines.zh: 大家好！我是 Karin Kanda——Kumon-mi 高中二年级学生！

lines.en: : Wow! What a beautiful day!
lines.zh: : 哇！今天天气真好！

lines.en: If I had to describe myself with one word, it would probably be “sunshine,” because I always try to look on the bright side!
lines.zh: 如果只能用一个词来形容我自己，那大概是「阳光」，因为我总是努力往好的一面看！

lines.en: Life’s too short to let your worries drag you down, which is why I always try to keep a positive attitude while helping others do the same thing as well!
lines.zh: 人生苦短，不该让烦恼把自己拖垮，所以我总是尽量保持积极的心态，也帮别人一起做到！

lines.en: Today, I’ve decided to walk to school.
lines.zh: 今天，我决定走路去上学。

lines.en: I live a little further away than most of the other girls, so I have to take the bus sometimes. But the weather is so perfect today that I figure it’s as good a chance as any to get some exercise in!
lines.zh: 我住得比其他大部分女生远一点，所以有时候得坐公交。但今天天气这么好，我觉得这正是锻炼身体的好机会！

lines.en: scene karinslife2
: Oh, shoot! Today is Ms. Sato’s birthday. I almost forgot! I should stop and buy her flowers on the way to school.
lines.zh: : 啊，糟了！今天是 Sato 老师的生日。我差点忘了！上学的路上得停下来给她买束花。

lines.en: Staying healthy is important, you know! A healthy body paves the way to a healthy mind! Or...wait. Maybe it was the other way around?
lines.zh: 保持健康很重要呢！健康的身体是健康心灵的前提！或者……等等。是不是反过来说的？

lines.en: I don’t know. I’ll have to ask my mom again. That’s {i}her{/i} catch-phrase after all. But there’s one thing I know for sure, and it’s that I wouldn’t be where I am today without her guidance.
lines.zh: 我也不知道。回头得再问问我妈。毕竟那是{i}她的{/i}口头禅。但有一件事我很确定，那就是如果没有她的教导，就不会有今天的我。

lines.en: I’m but the sum of all the good things the people I love have done for me, of course! And today is one more chance to spread some of that love around and help someone else in need!
lines.zh: 我不过是我爱的人为我做的所有好事的总和，当然啦！而今天又是一个机会，可以把这份爱分出去一些，去帮帮有需要的人！

lines.en: scene black
: Come on, feet! We’ve got some walking to do!
lines.zh: : 加油啊，脚！我们有的走了！

lines.en: scene karinslife3

After stopping at the local florist to buy my teacher, Ms. Sato, a bouquet of her favorite flowers (posies — I remember because they’re my favorite flower as well!), I sit down at my desk and prepare for my lessons!
lines.zh: 我先去了趟本地花店，给我的老师 Sato 老师买了一束她最喜欢的花（波斯菊——我记得是因为那也是我最喜欢的花！），然后在座位上坐好，准备上课！

lines.en: Today, I have an English test. And while it’s not my favorite subject (I have a soft spot for home-ec), I still find it very interesting!
lines.zh: 今天有英语测验。虽然它不是我最喜欢的科目（我特别偏爱家政课），但我觉得它很有意思！

lines.en: It’s amazing how there are so many different cultures out there, and how that’s often reflected in the way a language develops.
lines.zh: 世界上有那么多不同的文化，而且常常会体现在一门语言的演变方式里，真是奇妙。

lines.en: : Karin! I forgot my pencil! Can you lend me one again?
lines.zh: : Karin！我忘带铅笔了！能再借我一支吗？

lines.en: scene karinslife4
: Of course! You can just grab one out of my bag. I packed extras in case you forgot again.
lines.zh: : 当然！你自己从我包里拿一支就行。我多带了几支，以防你又忘。

lines.en: : Ahh! You’re such a lifesaver! Thank you so much!
lines.zh: : 啊！你真是救星！太谢谢你了！

lines.en: The girl who sits next to me is named Rena! I’ve known her since elementary school, and she’s always been a little forgetful. So I try to keep an eye out for her!
lines.zh: 坐我旁边的女孩叫 Rena！我从小学就认识她了，她一直有点丢三落四。所以我尽量多照看她一点！

lines.en: I don’t mind at all. I’ve been an older sister for practically my entire life, so it’s sort of just second-nature at this point for me to always be prepared for anything.
lines.zh: 我一点都不介意。我这辈子基本上一直在当姐姐，所以时刻做好准备对我来说已经算是第二天性了。

lines.en: scene karinslife3
Like today’s English test, for example! There are a lot of really hard questions on here, but I’ve been studying extra hard over the last week so none of them would surprise me.
lines.zh: 比如说今天的英语测验！卷子上有很多很难的题，但我上个星期特别用功地复习过，所以没有一道能难倒我。

lines.en: It’s reasons like that that keep me near the top of my class when it comes to grades!
lines.zh: 正是这样的原因，让我的成绩一直排在年级前列！

lines.en: : Psst. Karin.
lines.zh: : 喂喂。Karin。

lines.en: But that comes with its own set of difficulties as well.
lines.zh: 不过这也带来了它自己的一堆麻烦。

lines.en: scene karinslife5
: What’s wrong, Ayumi? Do you need a pencil as well?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Ayumi？你也要借铅笔吗？

lines.en: : Do you have the answer to number seven?
lines.zh: : 第七题的答案你有吗？

lines.en: scene karinslife6
: Of course I do. But I’ve told you before, I will not help you cheat. And I gave you plenty of opportunities to join my study group, so you can’t say I didn’t try to help.
lines.zh: : 我当然有。但我说过，我不会帮你作弊。而且我给过你很多机会来参加我的学习小组，所以你不能说我没试着帮你。

lines.en: : Ughhhhh but studying is so hard!
lines.zh: : 唔————可是学习好难啊！

lines.en: : It’s only hard because you don’t apply yourself. But I know you’re better than that, so-
lines.zh: : 难只是因为你不肯下功夫。但我知道你不至于这样，所以——

lines.en: : Kanda.
lines.zh: : Kanda。

lines.en: scene karinslife7
: Ah! I’m sorry, Ms. Sato! I’ll be quiet!
lines.zh: : 啊！对不起，Sato 老师！我闭嘴！

lines.en: scene black
No life is without difficulties, though! And I should be glad that mine are so simple and tiny when compared to the troubles many other people face.
lines.zh: 不过，没有哪种人生是没有困难的！而且我该庆幸，和许多人面对的烦恼相比，我的这些困难又小又简单。

lines.en: scene karinslife8
After school ends, I always try to help out some of the clubs before heading home.
lines.zh: 放学后，我总是先帮各个社团搭把手再回家。

lines.en: : Pleeeeeease, Karin?! The volleyball club needs you!
lines.zh: : 求————你了，Karin？！排球社需要你！

lines.en: : I’ll help out when I can, I promise! But I’m only allowed to be in two clubs at once, and I’ve already settled on softball and swimming.
lines.zh: : 能做的时候我一定帮，我保证！但我一次只能参加两个社团，而且我已经定了垒球和游泳。

lines.en: : What about basketball, then?! You’d be an amazing center! We’d make it to nationals easily!
lines.zh: : 那篮球呢？！你当中锋绝对超棒！我们轻轻松松就能打进全国大赛！

lines.en: scene karinslife9
: Nice try, Ena! But we all know nationals haven’t existed since the barrier was put up.
lines.zh: : 想得美，Ena！但谁都知道，自从那道屏障立起来之后，全国大赛早就不存在了。

lines.en: I guess I’d be called “popular” by most accounts, but that hasn’t ever really mattered to me.
lines.zh: 按大多数人的说法，我应该算「受欢迎」吧，但这对我来说从来都不重要。

lines.en: As far as I’m concerned, popularity is sort of a...realistic result to simply being a good person!
lines.zh: 在我看来，受欢迎不过是……单纯做个好人的一个挺现实的结果！

lines.en: If you do your best to make others happy, you’ll find that, more often than not, happy things will start happy-ning to you! Haha! Get it?
lines.zh: 只要你尽力让别人开心，你就会发现，开心的事多半也会开始开-心地找上门来！哈哈！懂了吗？

lines.en: In Buddhism, we call that karma. Or “what goes around comes around!” Or, as we learned in English recently, {i}the golden rule.{/i}
lines.zh: 在佛教里，我们管这叫因果报应。或者说「善有善报！」。或者用我们最近英语课上学到的说法，叫{i}黄金法则{/i}。

lines.en: But basically, the reason you’re seeing me swarmed by all of these girls is because they like me. And I like them! I like everybody! Which means I must be doing something right. Right?
lines.zh: 总之，你看到我被这些女孩围住，是因为她们喜欢我。而我也喜欢她们！我喜欢所有人！这说明我做对了点什么。对吧？

lines.en: scene black
Right?
lines.zh: 对吧？

lines.en: scene karinslife10
On the way home from school, I make sure to spend at least thirty minutes every day helping the elderly across a crowded intersection.
lines.zh: 放学回家的路上，我每天都会保证至少花三十分钟，扶老人走过那条拥挤的十字路口。

lines.en: My sister, Kirin, tells me this makes me “extra,” but what I think she means to say is “extra nice.”
lines.zh: 我妹妹 Kirin 说这样显得我「多余」，但我觉得她想说的其实是「多余地善良」。

lines.en: : There’s no need to hurry, Mrs. Okazaki. I’m not going anywhere. I can help you the whole way home if you need me to.
lines.zh: : 不用着急，Okazaki 太太。我不赶时间。需要的话我可以一路把您送回家。

lines.en: : Thank you, dear...You’re always so kind to me...Your parents must have raised you well...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，孩子……你对我总是这么好……你父母一定把你教得很好……

lines.en: : Oh, stop. I’m sure anyone else would do the same.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这么说。换作别人也一定会这么做的。

lines.en: : That’s not true at all, dear...most young folks don’t respect their elders the way they used to...you’re one of the good ones...
lines.zh: : 才不是呢，孩子……现在的年轻人大多不像从前那样尊敬长辈了……你是难得的好孩子……

lines.en: : Back in my day...we- ackh! Hck...nnph...ck!
lines.zh: : 我们那会儿……我——咳！咳……嗯……咳！

lines.en: scene karinslife11
: Are you alright?! Do you need to take a break?! Should I call an ambulance?!
lines.zh: : 您没事吧？！要不要歇一会儿？！要不要我叫救护车？！

lines.en: : Mmfh...mmf...no, dear...just my age...catching up to me...
lines.zh: : 唔……唔……不用，孩子……只是年纪……找上门来了……

lines.en: Mrs. Okazaki can’t talk or move as well as she used to.
lines.zh: Okazaki 太太说话和行动都不如从前了。

lines.en: A few months ago, her husband of fifty-five years passed away. And I think it’s taken a toll on her heart.
lines.zh: 几个月前，和她相伴五十五年的丈夫去世了。我觉得这对她的心脏打击很大。

lines.en: Poor thing...I can only imagine what that must be like. But I try not to because, not only does it makes my hands sweat, but my heart starts going dadadada at the thought of ever finding {i}anyone{/i} like that.
lines.zh: 可怜的人……我只能想象那是什么滋味。但我尽量不去想，因为一想，不光手心会出汗，一想到自己将来也要找到那样{i}一个人{/i}，心就开始咚咚咚地跳。

lines.en: There is {i}one{/i} person I have in mind, but...no. No, that’s crazy. And I shouldn’t be thinking about things like that anyway since I’m still in high school and...wait, what were we-
lines.zh: 我心里倒是{i}有个{/i}人选，但是……不。不，这太荒唐了。而且我还在上高中，本来就不该想这些……等等，我们刚说到哪——

lines.en: scene karinslife12
: Right! Mrs. Okazaki!
lines.zh: : 对了！Okazaki 太太！

lines.en: : Hm?...What about me, dear?...
lines.zh: : 嗯？……我怎么了，孩子？……

lines.en: scene karinslife13
: Oh! Nothing, sorry. It’s just...my mind was wandering.
lines.zh: : 啊！没什么，对不起。只是……我走神了。

lines.en: : Are you really okay, though? You don’t need me to call you a ride? Because I will. I have an emergency fund for little stuff like this and there’s no better way to spend it than-
lines.zh: : 不过您真的没事吗？要不要我帮您叫辆车？我真的可以。我有一笔应急钱，就是用来应付这种小事的，没有比这更值得花的地方了——

lines.en: : Don’t go wasting your hard-earned money...on an old bag like me...put it in a box under your bed...and spend it on a wedding one day...
lines.zh: : 别把你辛苦攒的钱……浪费在我这种老太婆身上……塞进床底下的盒子里……留着将来办婚礼用吧……

lines.en: : A wedding? Me? Marriage? Husband? Me? Noooo. Me?
lines.zh: : 婚礼？我？结婚？丈夫？我？不————会吧。我？

lines.en: : Heh...heh...heh...yes you...
lines.zh: : 呵……呵……呵……就是你……

lines.en: : You remind me...a lot of myself...back when I still...had hair like yours...
lines.zh: : 你让我想起……很多年前的自己……那时候我还有……像你这样的头发……

lines.en: : I was...a real beauty, you know...
lines.zh: : 我当年……可是个大美人呢……

lines.en: scene karinslife14
: And you still are. There aren’t many people out there who could pull off grey the way you do, Mrs. Okazaki. I really mean that.
lines.zh: : 您现在也还是。能把灰色驾驭得像您这样的人可不多，Okazaki 太太。我是真心的。

lines.en: : Heh...heh...heh...you flatter me...as always...
lines.zh: : 呵……呵……呵……你总是这么会说话……

lines.en: scene black
: You’re going to make...some man very happy one day, Karin...
lines.zh: : 你将来……会让某个男人非常幸福的，Karin……

lines.en: : Heheh...oh, stop...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……哎呀，别说了……

lines.en: scene karinslife15
My last stop before heading back home is the local grocery store!
lines.zh: 回家前的最后一站是本地的杂货店！

lines.en: My parents work late, so I wind up making dinner for the entire family a few nights every week.
lines.zh: 我父母下班晚，所以每周有几个晚上是由我给全家人做晚饭。

lines.en: My sister, Kirin again, isn’t always home to eat with us. But I still try to buy all of her favorite ingredients in case she {i}does{/i} decide to show up.
lines.zh: 我妹妹 Kirin 又不总在家吃饭。但我还是会把她爱吃的食材都买齐，万一她哪天{i}决定{/i}露面呢。

lines.en: Oh, and I only buy local products! It’s important to support your hometown’s economy, you know!
lines.zh: 对了，我只买本地产品！支持家乡的经济很重要呢！

lines.en: Kumon-mi might be sectioned off from the rest of the world, but we still get a lot of imported goods. Especially in places like this.
lines.zh: 虽然 Kumon-mi 与世界其他地方隔绝了，但我们还是能买到不少进口商品。尤其是在这种地方。

lines.en: But it’s because of people like me, who love the town so much, that our city is still thriving despite all that’s happened!
lines.zh: 但也正是因为有我这样热爱这座城市的人，发生了这么多事，我们的城市依然兴旺！

lines.en: Or, at least I like to {i}think{/i} that’s the reason. I’m sure the economy is a lot more complicated than that, but they haven’t taught us much about that in any of my classes yet.
lines.zh: 至少我愿意这么{i}想{/i}。经济肯定比这复杂得多，不过我的课上还没怎么教过这些。

lines.en: I’m excited to learn, though! There’s so much about the world that I still don’t understand!
lines.zh: 不过我很期待去学！这个世界我还有太多不懂的东西！

lines.en: Like, what are those little plastic things at the end of shoelaces called? Or what breeds of dog are hypoallergenic?
lines.zh: 比如说，鞋带末端那个小塑料叫什么来着？或者哪种狗是不容易过敏的品种？

lines.en: I’m sure there are a lot of questions you don’t know the answer to either. But that’s okay! We can figure them out together.
lines.zh: 肯定也有很多问题你也不知道答案。但没关系！我们可以一起弄明白。

lines.en: Because the only way to make this world a better place is to work as a team — and that’s why you’ll find me playing sports so often.
lines.zh: 因为让这个世界变好的唯一办法就是团队合作——所以我才这么爱参加体育运动。

lines.en: I’d do {i}anything{/i} for {i}anyone.{/i}
lines.zh: 我愿意为{i}任何人{/i}做{i}任何事{/i}。

lines.en: scene black
My sister, Kirin again, says that makes me a pushover.
lines.zh: 我妹妹 Kirin 又说，这说明我是个好欺负的老好人。

lines.en: And you know, maybe she’s right?
lines.zh: 而且你知道吗，也许她说得对？

lines.en: I’ll be the first to admit that I’m not perfect, despite what a lot of my classmates would tell you about me.
lines.zh: 我第一个承认我并不完美，尽管我的很多同学会跟你说些别的。

lines.en: I still cry sometimes. I still think about sad stuff.
lines.zh: 我还是会哭。还是会想起难过的事。

lines.en: But I do my best to keep it together because I want to be a good influence on everyone around me!
lines.zh: 但我尽力撑住，因为我想给身边的人做个好榜样！

lines.en: scene karinslife16
: I’m home!
lines.zh: : 我回来了！

lines.en: That comes with its own share of difficulties as well, though.
lines.zh: 不过这也带来了它自己的一份麻烦。

lines.en: scene karinslife17
: What’s for dinner?
lines.zh: : 晚饭吃什么？

lines.en: : Oh, Kirin! You’re here! That’s great! I was actually thinking of making potato leek soup and-
lines.zh: : 啊，Kirin！你在家啊！太好了！我正想着做土豆大葱汤呢，还有——

lines.en: : Pass. I’ll just eat at the dorm.
lines.zh: : 免了。我去宿舍吃。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: scene karinslife18
: Oh, and I ate your pudding. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦对了，我把你的布丁吃了。抱歉。

lines.en: scene karinslife19
: That’s okay.
lines.zh: : 没关系。

lines.en: : I didn’t want it anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我也不想吃。

lines.en: I don’t think my sister likes me very much.
lines.zh: 我觉得我妹妹不太喜欢我。

lines.en: And that makes me very sad.
lines.zh: 这让我很难过。

lines.en: She’s been my best friend ever since she was born. But it feels like, most of the time, she wants to be an only child.
lines.zh: 从她出生的那天起，她就是我最好的朋友。但大多数时候，感觉她都想当独生女。

lines.en: Most of the time, it feels like she wishes I would just die.
lines.zh: 大多数时候，感觉她巴不得我死了算了。

lines.en: I try my best to understand her, but it never really works out.
lines.zh: 我尽力去理解她，但从来都没什么用。

lines.en: I try to do nice things for her. But, most of the time, she tells me I’m being annoying.
lines.zh: 我尽力对她好。但大多数时候，她说我很烦人。

lines.en: Or that I’m only doing these things to show off.
lines.zh: 或者说我做这些只是为了显摆。

lines.en: But that’s not true at all.
lines.zh: 可根本不是那样。

lines.en: In fact, it’s {i}because{/i} of her that I am the way I am.
lines.zh: 事实上，正是{i}因为{/i}她，我才成了现在这个样子。

lines.en: I want to set a good example.
lines.zh: 我想做个好榜样。

lines.en: I want her to see that there’s more to life than whatever she sees right now.
lines.zh: 我想让她看到，生活不只是她现在看到的那样。

lines.en: And I know that being a teenager is hard.
lines.zh: 我知道当个青少年很不容易。

lines.en: I know that it can cloud your vision.
lines.zh: 我知道那会蒙住你的眼睛。

lines.en: But I don’t think she knows that I know that.
lines.zh: 但我觉得她并不知道我知道这些。

lines.en: And it makes me feel like I know nothing at all.
lines.zh: 这让我觉得自己其实什么都不知道。

lines.en: : Why are you just staring at me like that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么就这么盯着我看？

lines.en: I love my sister.
lines.zh: 我爱我妹妹。

lines.en: : No reason...
lines.zh: : 没什么……

lines.en: scene black
I just wish she loved me too.
lines.zh: 我只希望她也爱我。
